configuration.comment: Calculate the sum of estimated revenue grouping by [cr696_addressstate], filter by [cr696_dealdate] equal to 'this year', and order the total in descending order, output the state of the highest total estimated revenue.
configuration.query: Which state has the highest total estimated revenue in deals this year?
configuration.rephrase: The query will find out all customer deals where deal date is in this year, then calculate the total estimated revenue of each state, and keep the highest one.
configuration.standardsql: SELECT TOP 1 [cr696_addressstate], SUM([cr696_estimatedrevenue]) AS [totalEstimatedRevenue] FROM [cr696_customerdeal] WHERE [cr696_dealdate] = 'this year' GROUP BY [cr696_addressstate] ORDER BY [totalEstimatedRevenue] DESC
